text:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT fired: host gpu-node-47 (us-west-2a) - Kernel panic detected; kubelet NotReady. Severity: P1. Pager: anne. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

anne: acked. on it.

anne: checking node state
```
$ kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-node-47
gpu-node-47   NotReady   18m   KernelPanic
```

anne: pulling last logs from journalctl -k
```
Mar 14 01:22:09 kernel: nvme nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborting
Mar 14 01:22:09 kernel: nvme nvme0: abort status: 0x1
Mar 14 01:22:10 kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: nvme error: controller fatal
Mar 14 01:22:10 kernel: CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 5.15.0-rt
```

anne: looks like NVMe failure -> kernel panic. Host unreachable over ssh.

nisha: paging infra team + hardware. tagging @henry for RMA path. :warning:

henry: oncall-ack. thanks. please cordon the node and attempt graceful drain for migratable pods, we don't want more restarts.

anne: running cordon/drain now
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-47
kubectl drain gpu-node-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m
```

anne: drain started. 23 pods to evict, 3 are local-storage and will fail eviction.

devon: which workloads are those 3? need to know customer impact.

anne: two are model-cache pods (local disk cache), one is inference-worker-ml-local that uses hostpath. trying forcible eviction with safe fallback.

anne: updating routing to avoid this host; triggering fallback policy for affected endpoints (redwood-generate-prod -> fallback to redwood-generate-small).

infra-bot: routing-change applied: route redwood-generate-prod deprioritized for us-west-2a racks containing gpu-node-47.

jordan-cs: customers might see increased latency / 503s — any list of impacted accounts?

anne: partial list from monitoring: "contentgen-inc", "chatflowlabs", "docsuite-ai" - degraded 5xx rate increased from 0.2% -> 6% for 2m window. pushing incident note to status page.

henry: good. create incident record and note customer list. I'll open hardware RMA for nvme on gpu-node-47 and schedule replacement.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC12345 (hardware/kernel-panic). Linked PD: INC12345. RMA ticket: RMA-7890 opened.

nisha: running node diagnostics via provider API to confirm SMART/firmware state. also checking sibling nodes in rack for correlated failures.

anne: quick troubleshooting notes so far:
- host kernel panic shows NVMe controller fatal error
- node unreachable via SSH, Kubelet NotReady
- cordon + drain in progress; some local storage pods failed eviction
- routing fallback applied to reduce customer impact

devon: are there any active canary rollouts or batch jobs pinned to this node?

anne: one canary job (llm-alpha-canary) was running, evicted and restarted elsewhere. batch GPU training job will be requeued.

henry: escalation plan: hardware swap RMA -> replace NVMe -> run memtest and burn-in -> verify kubelet joins. If repair delayed >30m escalate to oncall-hardware senior.

anne: status update for pagerduty: ack -> investigating -> mitigation (cordon, routing fallback) -> hardware RMA opened. lowering alert to P2 for monitoring after cordon completes. :white_check_mark:

devon: leaving handoff to @devon in 10m once cordon/drain settle. I'll add runbooks and notes in Incident page.

anne: handing off now to devon for monitoring and customer comms. devon please confirm you picked up.

devon: picked up. will watch metrics, ensure fallback holds, and coordinate with hardware to schedule replacement. will update Slack and status page every 15m.

nisha: quick action item: gather kernel oops/panic logs and upload to incident doc. command: `journalctl -k -b -1 > /tmp/gpu-node-47-kernellog.txt` (if host comes back)

anne: note for postmortem: consider auto-evacuate for local-storage workloads or node evacuation policy when kernel panic detected.

jordan-cs: copying in customer comms template: "We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors impacting model inference for some customers in us-west-2. We have mitigations in place and expect service continuity via fallback models. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes."

henry: hardware team notified. RMA ETA 4 hours (replacement NVMe drive). If node doesn't come back before RMA we will reprovision a new host and migrate workloads.

devon: monitoring shows 503s decreased to 1.1% after routing change, latency 95p back to baseline. continuing to monitor.

anne: closing active paging for now; PD status -> acknowledged -> mitigation applied. leaving incident open for follow-up and hardware replacement.

devon: leaving final note: assigned to devon for follow-up; next update scheduled in 15m.

infra-bot: Handoff logged: previous_oncall=anne, current_oncall=devon, incident=INC12345, timestamp=1777010360

devon: thanks all. I'll file a follow-up PR for improving eviction behavior for hostpath cache pods.

anne: thx team :pray:"
